name: Build the squad — club created, not yet playable
description: An organiser opened a club and it cannot field a game yet. This is the largest measured leak in the funnel: of ~56 real clubs created, fewer than half ever got a second member in, and only 16 reached a playable roster. IMPORTANT: this journey deliberately does NOT exit when the first member joins — one player is not a game. It exits on Club Became Playable (10+), and the three touches escalate in interval (3 / 7 / 14 days) and change in KIND rather than repeating a reminder. The app now sends club_size, club_stage, club_missing and clubs_admin as user attributes so the copy can name the club's real position; if the journey builder supports an attribute split, branch the body on club_stage using the reference copy in _copyByStage below. Otherwise the neutral bodies here are safe at every size — none of them says 'your first player'.

config._note: The moment a club exists. Every organiser passes through here exactly once per club.
Three days. An organiser who pasted the link into WhatsApp on day one is already done and leaves through `did` — saying anything to them would be noise.

config.title: המועדון שלך מוכן
config.body: רק אתה רואה אותו כרגע. שלח את הקישור לקבוצת הוואטסאפ — מי שלוחץ נכנס ישר פנימה.
config._note: Touch 1 = HOW. The commonest reason a club stays empty is that nobody knew sharing was one tap.
A week, not another three days. The gap grows on purpose: somebody who ignored the first message will not be persuaded by the same message sooner.

config.title: עוד כמה שחקנים ויש מחזור
config.body: מרגע שיש סגל, המחזור השבועי נפתח לבד והכוחות מתאזנים בלי ויכוח במגרש.
config._note: Touch 2 = WHY. Not a reminder — the payoff, which is a different argument from touch 1.
Two weeks. The last wait, and the longest.

config.title: המועדון שלך עדיין מחכה
config.body: הקישור עדיין פעיל — שיתוף אחד בקבוצה וזה מתחיל לזוז.
config._note: Touch 3 and LAST. Three unanswered touches mean the answer is no; a fourth costs the notification permission and buys nothing.

_copyByStage._note: Reference copy if the body can be branched on the club_stage attribute. The rule behind it: never name a number the organiser has already beaten, and never say 'first' to somebody who has three.
_copyByStage.empty: רק אתה רואה את המועדון כרגע. שלח את הקישור לקבוצה ומי שלוחץ נכנס ישר פנימה.
_copyByStage.seeded: ההתחלה נעשתה. ל-5 על 5 צריך בערך 10 — עוד כמה שיתופים ואתם שם.
_copyByStage.forming: הסגל מתחיל להיראות. מכאן הכוחות כבר מתאזנים לבד, בלי ויכוח במגרש.
_copyByStage.nearly: אתם ממש על הקו. עוד שניים ויש לכם מחזור מלא.
